The IoT empowers connectivity of physical object with the real-time communication by ESP8266 and data logged into cloud. The smart shelf rack and products details are logged into Database Management system are some desirable characteristics that result.

articleTitle: Hyperlocal Covert Communication using FM Radio Waves
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, a proposal is presented to put light into the possibility of using FM radio waves for hyperlocal covert communication. In this proposal, FM radio waves are used to send secret information through phase encoding of audio signal. This kind of information hiding is called steganography. The data to be hidden is encrypted and inserted by modulating phase value of audio signal. Phase coding is being used instead of Spread Spectrum Encoding or Least Significant Bit(LSB) based techniques for covert communication using FM radio waves. It is observed that the performance of the proposed algorithm is good.

articleTitle: Low Power and Less Delay Circuit Shared Static Flip-Flop (LDCSSFF) for Digital Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: A modified flip flop for high speed and low power digital applications is designed. The proposed less delay circuit shared static flip flop (LDCS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>FF) includes five number of NOR gates and back-to-back inverters. The inverter is given with a clock signal and the following signal is given as input to the NOR gates. The proposed LDCS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>FF is a master slave flip flop act as a storage element. The proposed LDCS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>FF is simulated on Synopsys tool HSPICE under 32 nm BSIM4 model card for bulk CMOS technology of PTM model. The proposed LDCS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>FF as 24 transistors with delay of 0.3 ns at 1 V applied voltage and power dissipation of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$59.6\ \mu\mathrm{W}$</tex> at 0.8 V applied voltage.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Electrical Safety and Protection Systems for Hybrid Electric Cars
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Fossil fuels, such as coal, oil, and natural gas, are the primary sources of energy at the moment. However, oil, natural gas, and coal will run out in 53 years, 54 years, and 110 years, respectively, at present production rates. Aside from depleting fossil fuel sources, there is an ever-increasing need for a cleaner, more efficient form of transportation. This has acted as a catalyst for the development of electrical mobility. Hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs) have progressed beyond their early stages and are proving to be a potential solution to the planet's actual existential problem. The energy storage system, motor, and bidirectional converter are the three major components of HEVs. The performance of HEVs is extremely dependent on these parts and their design. To safeguard the driver from the dangers posed by high voltage sources, safety and protection measures are equally important. Customers' safety is of prime importance for commercialization of HEVs. As a result, the vehicle's shutdown system plays a crucial role in protecting the vehicle's health and the driver's safety. This research focuses on the major factors involved in the development of an FSAE hybrid electric car and provides an optimal shutdown system design while considering the risks and dangers in accordance with Formula Hybrid Competition rules.

articleTitle: Speed and Power Efficient Vedic Multiplier using Adders with MUX
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This paper project an competent vedic multiplier design using adders with multiplexer structure. To obtain faster results and optimized circuit design, Vedic multiplier is used. Multiplier determines the throughput in arithmetic operations and performance faster in many of the real time applications. Vedic Multiplier is a kind of low power and fast multipliers. Vedic multiplier by means of urdhva tiryagbhyam sutra is designed for 8-bit numbers. Here for performance analysis delay and power of a multiplier are considered. To get an effective output, we have replaced the ripple carry adder with multiplexer as an substitute instead of traditional ripple carry adder. By using this customized adder, it is possible to achieve minimum gate delay with reduced power consumption. Instead of using conventional carry save adder it is replaced with carry save adder using multiplexer in order to obtain output with high efficiency. By considering both ripple carry adder and carry save adder the speed and power parameters are compared. In Vedic Mathematics there are 16 Sutras, in which 2 Sutras namely Urdhva Tiryagbhyam Sutra and Nikhilam Sutra have been considered for the purpose of doing multiplication process for two 8-bit numbers. In this two 8-bit multiplication process, we have implemented Urdhva Triyagbhyam Sutra which is of vertical and crosswise.

articleTitle: Indoor Automated Vertical Farming Using The Concept Of Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Vertical cultivating is the metropolitan cultivating of organic products, vegetables and grains inside a structure in a city or metropolitan focus, in which floors are intended to oblige certain yields. This is a high-level degree of agribusiness and joins the procedure, collecting method, water the executives and harvest development. The Micro matrix framework uses the disseminated energy assets including the ordinary electric lattice and an all-around cutting edge and controlled roof sun powered cluster and by utilizing the control sensors, a cloud-associated, request side energy the executives programming stage, will be incorporated in the new framework, permitting the Micro network framework to deal with the sustainable power sources and control the energy spent. The framework will likewise be prepared to work in the island mode so the ranch stays controlled during sudden blackouts. During exceptionally high energy request period supply will be drawn from the framework in case the sun powered doesn't satisfy the energy needs and during periods were the energy request is low we can supply back to the matrix. This will permit a two-way correspondence between the shopper and the energy provider. The course of vertical cultivating is exceptionally robotized requiring sensors, screens and other controlling instruments to impersonate the outer conditions required by the light like light, temperature and other ecological conditions.

articleTitle: A Simulation of Smart Pelican Crossing with Python
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: We develop a virtual simulation system of a smart pelican crossing on PC. First, a snapshot of the specified monitoring area is taken with a webcam on PC frame by frame. In order to detect motion, next, the following image-processing is done for each frame by Python-OpenCV package: frame difference, grayscale conversion, Gaussian blur, image segmentation, image dilation, finding counters, and drawing rectangles. Then, traffic and pedestrian lights change on PC if motion is detected. Also, we measure the execution time for one frame by the use of Python time library. It is 0.02041 seconds with the microprocessor Intel Core i3 on Dell Latitude 3580, which means that the load of the developed simulation system is not so heavy on PC. Therefore, the simulation runs smoothly.

articleTitle: RANFO: An Intelligent Anomaly Detection in IoT Edge Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Computer threats on the Internet of Things (IoT) are increasingly changing as devices, apps, and communication networks become increasingly networked and interconnected. When attacks on IoT networks result in long-term downtime, it reduces the availability of critical end-user programmers, hikes costs, and lowers revenue. In this proposed work, we introduce the Random Forest Intrusion Detection System (RANFO-IDS), which is designed to secure IoT systems that are intrinsically connected. According to our tests, the proposed entry-level system can effectively enter the real-world entrance. The suggested RANFO-IDS technique has been shown to detect a number of damaging attacks, including Denial of Service (DOS) attack, R2L attack, Probe attack, and U2L attack.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Charge Controller for Electric Vehicle with Vehicle to Grid System
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Electric vehicles are quickly becoming a thing of the future, with their use of clean energy being seen as one of the keys to reducing greenhouse gas emissions. The increased usage of electric vehicles has resulted in them now being used as sources of energy, feeding power to the grid via Vehicle to Grid systems. The incorporation of such systems requires sophisticated charging setups in order to ensure bidirectional power flow, along with suitable grid synchronization mechanisms. Each electric vehicle system is further accompanied with a battery controller, to regulate the battery voltage and current and ensure safe operation during charging. This paper proposes a battery controller system using a Phase Shifted Full Bridge (PSFB) converter. Further, a bidirectional electric vehicle charging setup is presented, employing the battery charge controller, and the results of both simulations are analyzed. All simulations are performed in the Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Conditioning of Fuel Cell under Dynamic Switching of Load using Typhoon HIL Software
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Fuel cell plays a major role in the modern trend technology such as an electric vehicle, smart grid, telecommu-nication, and medical application, etc. In this work, A short literature survey has been presented on the fuel cell based on the technology, importance, and application for conditioning the electrical power. Also, The Simulation performance of fuel cell with dynamic switching of loads is carried-out through the PI (Proportional + integral) controller based closed-loop boost converter. The switching pulses and the load voltages are monitored through PI controller. The load power provided by the fuel cell with closed loop boost converter and maintains constant output voltage at the load. The source, loads variations, and its performance are simulated in real-time software typhoon HIL control center platform.

articleTitle: Performance and Anaylsis of a Grid Connected Hybrid Power System using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: In this paper, focus on FPGA based digital controller. The hybrid system is improving the system efficiency and to extract DC power from solar PV modules. The DC load is connected for if load demand is required then we have connected to the load. In this study, the MPPT controller is designed for the charge and discharge mode based on analysis of the converter. In these paper the grid connected PV system is developed on FPGA-based MPPT controller. Then, to develop the effective of control strategy is to manage the power flow equally AC & DC sides. This system simulated in MTTLAB Tools and FPGA System.

articleTitle: Block Chain Based Car Air Unlock System
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This project depicts that the next generation easy way for the vehicle unlock and prevent from the theft management process. Here the project enhance the car unlock methodology using key fob for the car system. This will create the easy method for the car unlock system and will control the theft by using block chain method in it. It will creates the best result in future technology and it can uses the motion to open or lock the door. Finally it will gives the best way of solution for control theft, simple methodology for locking system and block chain security. The security system must be in advance in next generation. If the key fob is taken by someone, there is no issues because the key fob pattern only knows by owner of the car. So it will enhance the security mode.

articleTitle: Design of Decoupled Current Controller for Back to Back Modular Multilevel Converter Based HVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) is becoming utmost successful in-recent multilevel configurations, particularly for medium and high voltage applications. A typical application of MMC's is used to control active and reactive power. The design of a decoupled current controller presented in this paper, which allows for the effective regulation of active and reactive power. The controller parameters are fine-tuned depending on the intended output for the input disturbance. The performance of the MMC-based High voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) transmission system joining two ac networks has been analyzed from transient simulation analysis with proposed controller parameters using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Refinement Image Regeneration
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: With the recent spurt in technological advancements, especially the advent of autonomous navigation, image processing has become ubiquitous in everyday life. Image reconstruction is an imaging application aimed at rebuilding images from a variety of features obtained from sparse input ground truths or input sources. In this work, we present an image reconstruction method to recreate and represent detailed images solely from binary edges and flat color using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) for a universal application, whereas all major recent breakthroughs are related to either medical imaging or noise removal. Our work has yielded promising results and we were able to obtain realistic images of objects and human faces with original as well as altered feature sets. We present here the results with both qualitative and quantitative comparisons with some benchmark frameworks.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Portable Diagnostic System for the Detection of Adulteration in Food Supplements
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Food supplements or nutrition supplements are those which give nutrition other than normal food that we are consuming and also used to maintain diet. Food supplements are Vitamins, Minerals, Amino and Fatty acids, etc. They are very much important in everyone's diet to maintain proper health. As our lives are turning more towards nature nowadays many people were likely to consume healthy products to live a sustained life. But many of the food supplement products that are available in the market are not of pure quality as they are adulterated by some of the components. To make maximum profit, shopkeepers add adulterants to the food products thus leading to several diseases in the human race. In a report issued by the Public Health Foundation of India, more than 80% of premature deaths are the result of poor food quality. To avoid such conditions there must be a food adulteration monitoring system that is used to detect the quality of food supplements by checking whether the sample is adulterated or not. Thus, monitoring the food adulteration is a must and it stops the consumer from consuming poor-quality products that also will ensure their health and will save money.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Analysis of Single Phase Inverter using Cuckoo Search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: This study introduces a novel Cuckoo Search Algorithm for determining the best Gate pulse angle for an H-Bridge inverter. With the newly designed cuckoo search algorithms, the goal of selective harmonic elimination (SHE) output voltage regulation and removing of peculiar harmonics is achieved, and then a solution of optimum switching value is determined. In a three-level inverter, the primary aim of an inverter is to maintain a desired fundamental component of the output voltage. It's also crucial to maintain the harmonic components of the output voltage under prescribed harmonic limits. As a result, the objective of this research is to develop a harmonic minimization function that optimises the switching angles of H-bridge inverters. The Cuckoo Search (CS) method is utilised to calculate the switching angles, which are then used to produce the switching pattern for firing the H-bridges inverter. Experimental findings acquired from a hardware prototype of an H-Bridge Inverter equipped with an FPGA controller are provided to verify the simulation results and prove the capabilities of the Cuckoo Search optimised firing strategy in minimising of harmonics.

articleTitle: Study of Current Signatures for Electrical Faults Detection in Squirrel Cage Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 Innovations in Power and Advanced Computing Technologies (i-PACT)
abstract: Induction machine (IM) is the most widely used motor in industries. Induction motor is subjected to various defects. Detection of induction motor fault is vital for lowering the cost of maintenance and to prevent from sudden shutdown. This work demonstrates electrical faults classifying algorithm for detection of normal, open circuit and short circuit IM conditions. In this work, from measured stator current four time domain features have been extracted. The statistical feature plots of three conditions of IM are thoroughly investigated. The results have shown, single feature variance as well as standard deviation is performing well with k-nearest neighbor in comparison with linear discriminant analysis classifier, Naïve Bayesian classifiers and support vector machine classifier.
